dataset_name: NRSC/ISRO Bihar Flood Hazard Zonation Atlas
license: National Remote Sensing Centre (NRSC), Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) Open Disaster Management Support
spatial_resolution: Multi-mission optical and microwave satellite synthesis (nominal 30m - 50m resolution)
temporal_coverage: Historical multi-decadal observation record: 1998 to 2019 (22 flood years)
geographic_coverage: Bihar state, India (district and block level hazard zonation)

label_definition.1: Very Low Hazard (inundated 1-2 times in 22 years)
label_definition.5: Very High Hazard (inundated >15 times in 22 years)

known_limitations: Represents HISTORICAL frequency of flood inundation over 1998-2019, NOT current or active inundation.
Must not be equated with present-day flood status or dynamic risk for any single day.
Zonation does not reflect infrastructure built after 2019 (such as newly constructed embankments or drainage upgrades).
